children: Revival Gold amended its advance notice by-law, removing the 65-day maximum notice period for director nominations while retaining the 30-day minimum. Shareholders will vote to confirm the amendment on November 18, 2026.
Changes the director nomination process and addresses ISS's stated objection to the by-law.
Shareholder nominations must still be submitted at least 30 days before the annual meeting.
Shareholder confirmation vote set for Nov. 18, 2026
The amendment ceases to be effective unless approved by a majority of votes cast at the meeting.

This is a governance change made after ISS recommended voting against the original by-law; it does not report a change to Revival Gold's operating or financial outlook. The next catalyst is the November 18, 2026 shareholder vote and the required final acceptance from the TSX Venture Exchange.
